label: Подумать
description: A 10-sentence conjugation card for подумать (to think, to give thought).

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Perfective future, first-person. 'Подумаю' is the perfective future of подумать; the simple form already means future because the verb is perfective. The imperfective partner is думать.
Strategic focus: Perfective future, second-person. 'Подумаешь' shows the -ешь ending. 'Сначала... потом' frames a single completed act of thinking before speaking.
Strategic focus: Perfective future, third-person. 'Подумает' is the он-form ending in -ет. 'Над твоим предложением' uses the instrumental after над to mark the object of thought.
Strategic focus: Perfective future, first-person plural. 'Подумаем' shows the мы-ending -ем. Two perfective verbs in a row picture two finished steps, thinking then answering.
Strategic focus: Perfective future, third-person plural. 'Подумают' closes the future paradigm with the -ют ending. 'О будущем' is prepositional, the case подумать takes with о.

missions.phrase: Он подумал и согласился со мной.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Masculine past tense. 'Подумал' is the masculine singular past of perfective подумать. The aspect marks a brief, completed moment of reflection.
Strategic focus: Feminine past tense. 'Подумала' adds the feminine -а ending. 'О своих родителях' is prepositional after о, the typical object of подумать.
Strategic focus: Plural past tense. 'Подумали' is the plural past ending in -и. Two perfective verbs depict the finished sequence of deciding.
Strategic focus: Singular imperative. 'Подумай' is the informal command of perfective подумать. The perfective stresses one careful act of reflection before a choice.

missions.phrase: Нам надо подумать о новом плане.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Modal infinitive use. 'Надо' takes the bare infinitive 'подумать'. The dative 'нам' marks who must reflect; 'о новом плане' is prepositional.
